image_description: A night-time shot of a street sign pole with multiple illuminated signs. The top two signs are rectangular, white with red/black text, appearing to read 'ONE WAY' but with distorted/gibberish lettering. Below them are two darker, horizontal signs with glowing orange/yellow text that is illegible and structurally nonsensical. The pole is dark and textured, set against a pitch-black background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text attempts to spell 'ONE WAY' but fails catastrophically. Letters are fused, malformed, and nonsensical (e.g., the 'O' is a broken circle, 'N' is distorted). This is a classic AI generation failure in rendering text.
The glowing orange text is completely illegible hallucinations. It consists of random stroke-like patterns that mimic the texture of text without forming any recognizable characters or words.
The physical mechanism holding the signs to the pole is missing or melted. The signs appear to float or merge into the pole without logical hardware support.
The signs appear to emit light rather than reflect it. The glow is uneven and bleeds into the surrounding darkness in an unnatural way, lacking the sharp edges of real illuminated signage.
